name: catch-a-liar
description: 30-line C program that prints "using fast path: yes" but actually runs the O(n) fallback -- the same silent-fallback failure mode as llama.cpp's KleidiAI banner (see the repo README), with no Arm hardware and no model download required.
expected_verdict_summary: MISMATCH: binary prints "using fast path: yes" but fast_path_sum() was never called (0 hits)
